scope: Primary proceedings, author original manuscripts/project pages/institutional report. Not exhaustive web search; not every paper read in full; no datasets/cloned repos/dependencies downloaded.

sources.title: Automatic Goal Generation for Reinforcement Learning Agents
sources.read_scope: 摘要、PDF问题/假设/目标难度章节
sources.decision: 按能力选择目标，适合更细课程；不声称复现GAN或独创课程

sources.title: Horizon Generalization in Reinforcement Learning
sources.decision: 近距离能力不自动推出远距离能力；理论有假设，不引入路点规划

sources.title: Contrastive Learning as Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning
sources.decision: 表征内积可表达目标条件价值；需要合适轨迹/目标标签与独立Critic验证

sources.title: Distributional Distance Classifiers for Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning
sources.read_scope: 机构摘要、workshop PDF可读检索片段
sources.decision: 到达时间与到达概率必须区分；不能把成功样本时长当所有策略的可达距离

sources.title: Scaling Goal-conditioned Reinforcement Learning with Multistep Quasimetric Distances
sources.decision: 多步MC拟合准度量；暂不复制价值梯度，更不引入图搜索

sources.title: Dual Goal Representations
sources.decision: 时间关系表示属于已有研究；新增goal encoder不是原创性证明

sources.title: SVL: Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning as Survival Learning
sources.read_scope: 摘要、方法/删失/层次actor目录与开篇
sources.decision: hazard/到达时间/删失已存在；借鉴标签契约，原层次Actor不照搬

sources.title: Survival Reinforcement Learning: Toward Scalable Self-Supervised RL
sources.venue: arXiv 2026 v2，未据此声称正式录用
sources.decision: 目标驻留与一次到达不同；本项目不静默改变terminate-on-GOAL目标

sources.title: Arrive and Survive: Scaling Safe Goal-Conditioned Policy Learning from One-Bit Failure Signals
sources.venue: arXiv 2026 v1，未据此声称正式录用
sources.read_scope: 摘要、方法/实现/失败vs删失技术条件目录与开篇
sources.decision: 失败质量校正是强近邻；碰撞不能当普通时间截断，失败预测头本身非新

sources.title: SafeAdapt: Provably Safe Policy Updates in Deep Reinforcement Learning
sources.read_scope: 摘要、相关工作、方法/假设/安全规格节目录与开篇
sources.decision: 已研究安全保持和参数投影；有限/离散及unsafe标签等假设不能搬成连续车保证

sources.title: Stochastic Minimum-Cost Reach-Avoid Reinforcement Learning
sources.decision: 概率reach-avoid与成本共同优化已有理论；当前原生回归不是该证书

sources.title: Safe Multi-Agent Navigation guided by Goal-Conditioned Safe Reinforcement Learning
sources.decision: 联合距离/安全价值有先例；其图和路点执行与Stage契约冲突，不采用

sources.title: Offline Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning for Safety-Critical Tasks with Recovery Policy
sources.decision: 安全GCRL已有研究；恢复策略方案不作为单Actor运行时控制器

sources.title: Success-Conditioning as Policy Improvement: The Optimization Problem Solved by Imitating Success
sources.decision: 精确success-conditioning的理论不等于有限神经BC；T231/T243等失败不能被理论抹去
